purpose: Official sources and availability; cited pages support the descriptions below, not model efficacy or mirror authenticity.

sources.title: DrivenData GEMS problem description, metric and submission format
sources.evidence: Fault predictions are evaluated against newly expert-labeled faults; 300 m triangular kernel; alpha 0.2, beta 0.8; single-band float32, EPSG:32611, 100 m, values [0,1].
sources.access: Public page fetched; competition data page redirects to login.

sources.title: DrivenData GEMS overview
sources.evidence: Describes two scoring rounds, external-data license requirement and published deadline.

sources.title: DrivenData staff clarification of known-fault scoring mask
sources.evidence: Staff state the known-fault mask is pixel-exact; new truth can lie within 300 m of known faults.
sources.access: Public forum fetched; do not assume a buffered scoring mask.

sources.title: National Laboratory of the Rockies GEMS official rules PDF
sources.evidence: Official rule document; participants should verify eligibility and terms against the latest version.

sources.title: USGS GeoDAWN airborne magnetic and radiometric surveys
sources.evidence: Official data release describes magnetic and radiometric surveys and GeoTIFF grids; landing page lists CC0.
sources.access: Landing page fetched; local derived rasters restored from owner mirror, not compared with the official bytes.

sources.title: DOE Geothermal Data Repository: INGENIOUS Great Basin compilation
sources.evidence: Public datasets include 2 m probes, geological faults, paleogeothermal deposits, well/spring chemistry, seismicity and related layers; page lists CC BY 4.0.
sources.access: Landing page fetched; owner-mirrored files restored and hash checked, but not compared with the official files.

sources.title: USGS 3D Elevation Program
sources.evidence: USGS describes elevation and lidar products; landing page says products are free and without use restrictions.
sources.access: Landing page fetched; coverage and provenance of each derived owner-mirror tile have not been independently confirmed.

sources.title: NASA OPERA project and surface-displacement products
sources.evidence: NASA describes OPERA DISP-S1, 30 m line-of-sight displacement across North America from 2016 onward, openly shared; displacement is not proof of faulting.
sources.access: Product metadata and open-sharing statement fetched; relevant tiles, dates, acquisition and usable coverage have not been verified. Not used in this run.

sources.title: DrivenData GEMS reference solution
sources.evidence: Organizer reference notebook supports CPU and GPU environments; data must be obtained separately.
sources.access: Public repository reviewed; no GPU used in this audit.

sources.title: DrivenData staff submission-limit clarification
sources.evidence: Staff say the limit displayed on the submission page takes precedence over the weekly number in the official rules.
sources.access: Public forum fetched; this account's actual quota and reset time were not checked.

sources.title: USGS structural discontinuities and hydrothermal systems
sources.evidence: Published modeling connects strain/stress concentration to bends, steps and fault terminations; it does not validate any raster in this repository.

sources.title: USGS Surprise Valley potential-field mapping
sources.evidence: A major linear magnetic high is interpreted and supported as a buried dike swarm, illustrating an important non-fault mimic.
sources.access: Official public abstract reviewed; no data file downloaded.

sources.title: USGS: Influence of pre-existing structures on geothermal springs in Surprise Valley
sources.evidence: Official USGS publication abstract reports springs along an interpreted intrabasin magnetic high and at local breaks/bends in that anomaly. This is rationale for a falsifiable feature hypothesis, not evidence that the proposed detector works in the competition footprint.
sources.access: Official publication record discoverable in search results on 2026-10-29. Full report/data and local coverage were not downloaded in this session.

sources.title: USGS/OSTI: Discovering blind geothermal systems in the Great Basin region
sources.evidence: Official publication summary reports that southeastern Gabbs Valley analysis combined a displacement-transfer/fault-intersection setting, terminating/intersecting gravity gradients, magnetic low, 2 m temperature anomaly, low resistivity, and geothermometry; subsequent temperature-gradient drilling supported a blind system. This is a case-study rationale, not validation of the proposed model.
sources.access: Official USGS publication record and abstract snippet reviewed via search on 2026-10-29; underlying source data were not downloaded or checked.

sources.title: USGS Open-File Report 2005-1207: Great Basin regional heat-flow supporting data
sources.evidence: Official report record describes supporting data for regional Great Basin heat-flow studies and notes that hydrologic and tectonic processes affect heat flow. It is a possible source for a nuisance-adjusted residual hypothesis; local observation coverage and exact data files remain unverified.
sources.access: Official report page identified in search on 2026-10-29; no dataset files downloaded or coverage checked.

sources.title: DOE Geothermal Data Repository: INGENIOUS Great Basin Regional Dataset Compilation
sources.evidence: Public catalog record describes a regional compilation including 2 m temperature probes, geophysics, heat flow, wells/springs, and related data. Catalog listing does not prove a particular file or tile is locally available or correctly aligned.
sources.access: Official GDR catalog record found in search results on 2026-10-29; no raw data downloaded in this session.

review_scope_note: 2026-10-29 additions are based on official USGS/DOE catalog page search excerpts; they support scientific rationale and public catalog descriptions only. No raw source data was downloaded or independently validated in this session.
